lines.zh: 燃烧平原上我贴着灰走
lines.en: On the burning plains I move close to the ash

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，几乎不留印
lines.en: My steps are light, hardly leaving prints
I walk along the edges of the cracks

lines.zh: 我绕开亮的地方，太显眼
lines.en: I avoid the bright spots, too visible

lines.zh: 六条腿落下去，火星就散
lines.en: My six legs land and embers scatter
I change direction in the ash

lines.zh: 这里到处都是烟，很好藏
lines.en: Smoke everywhere here, good for hiding

lines.zh: 我走近路，不跟人走大路
lines.en: I take the short way, not the main road

lines.zh: 我的壳在火光下会变色
lines.en: My shell shifts color in the firelight
I keep low as I walk

lines.zh: 脚下的地是硬的，被烧过
lines.en: The ground is hard, burnt
I take two steps and stop to listen
I walk in old prints to save effort

lines.zh: 地上有焦黑的骨头，我跨过去
lines.en: Charred bones on the ground, I step over them

lines.zh: 我顺着风向走，味道不飘
lines.en: I move with the wind, so my scent does not carry

lines.zh: 这里没有一块完整的石头
lines.en: Not one whole stone in this place
I crouch behind a heap of ash
Nobody passes here
The fire's voice covers everything
My shell is all ash
I wait to see who comes this stretch
The wind on the burning plains changes often

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一块焦木
lines.en: Still as I am, I look like charred wood
I keep my head low, only my eyes showing
This stretch is my hunting ground
A figure far off, I have noted it

lines.zh: 灰落在我的背上，我不抖
lines.en: Ash settles on my back, I do not shake
I listen first, then move
You have come to this stretch

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛在灰里亮
lines.en: I lift my head, my eyes bright in the ash
You reek of somewhere else
I am shorter than you, but I am fast
On this plain, only you and I

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会招来别人
lines.en: I do not call out, it would bring others

lines.zh: 你的影子投到我这片灰上
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my ash
Do not put your hand down
On the burning plains, I've waited long.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我已经挪了位置
lines.en: When you turn, I have already moved
A split has opened in my plate
I rolled half a turn and got up

lines.zh: 我退了很远，灰都翻起来
lines.en: I backed far, churning the ash
That slowed me half a beat
It hurts, but I cannot stop
My blood darkens in the ash
I flatten and let it pass
I grit my teeth without a sound
One more and I hide
You hold it up over the ash
I sniff, and do not move

lines.zh: 这儿的灰里连虫都没有
lines.en: There is not even an insect in this ash
Your hand shook, I saw it
I am closer than you think
I do not take things from hands
Set it down and back three paces
The heat has burned the smell away

lines.zh: 你还没明白我在等什么
lines.en: You still do not see what I am waiting for

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我已经侧开了
lines.en: You charged and I had already turned
My shell caught your elbow
Light, but well placed
I step back and the ash spreads
Do not crowd me, I am measuring distance
The ash under you gives no footing
Your hand brushed my horn

lines.zh: 我记住了你撞过来的方向
lines.en: I have the direction you came from

lines.zh: 我从侧后挪到了你背后
lines.en: I slipped from your flank to your back
Touch me again and it starts
Few of my kind on this stretch
I have waited here a long while
In the ash you cannot tell one from another

lines.zh: 壳的颜色对上了，才谈得上
lines.en: Only if the shells match is it worth speaking of
When the fire shifts, everything is confused
Solitude suits me better
Nothing stays here long
The wind takes the scent away
Survive first
I brush the ash aside with my forelegs
There is something under the ash
It is hot, I do not let go
This may be of some use
With ash on it, it cannot be seen
It is harder than my shell
I carry it a little way off
I do not take what has an owner
The shadow in the ash is wrong
I flatten, legs drawn in
You have stepped into my range

lines.zh: 烟里飘来铁腥，就是你了。
lines.en: Iron and blood drift through the smoke — it is you.

lines.zh: 燃烧平原上只有这一条路
lines.en: Only one road across the burning plains
I go around the fire and come from the side
You looked back, perfect

lines.zh: 我的壳，火光照不出颜色
lines.en: In the firelight my shell shows no color
There is no way out of this stretch
At the third muffled sound in the ash, I pounce.

lines.zh: 我的头低下来，几乎碰到灰
lines.en: My head drops until it nearly touches the ash
A sound in the ash, it is you
I follow close along the ash

lines.zh: 你跑的方向，前面是火墙
lines.en: The way you run leads to a wall of fire
I am faster than I look
Your prints are deep in the ash
I stay off your flank
The firelight swallows my shadow
When you stop, I close in
The smoke here blinds people

lines.zh: 我的壳上都是灰，看不出轮廓
lines.en: Ash covers my shell, no outline shows
You switched hands, I heard it
Further on, you lose your retreat
I never once let you hear me

lines.zh: 我一直在换位置，你没发现
lines.en: I keep shifting position, you have not noticed

lines.zh: 火墙挡住了你回头的路
lines.en: The fire wall blocks your way back
I pounce and land on your shoulder

lines.zh: 我的前腿勾住你的衣领
lines.en: My forelegs hook your collar
That was short and quick
You were pulled half a step off balance
I bite your wrist
We kicked up a cloud of ash
You back off, and I back with you
That one missed the vital spot
Your hand opened and it fell
I let go and drop back into the ash
A shape has appeared behind the ash heap
I step out of the smoke
There is one more on the burning plains

lines.zh: 我的壳上还带着地里的灰
lines.en: My shell still carries earth and ash

lines.zh: 火光照到我的角，一亮又暗
lines.en: The firelight catches my horn, then dims
I lift a foot and ash falls
The sound of this stretch has changed
I crouch low and move forward
There is one more shadow in the smoke
The fire came and I dug into the ash

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，壳磕了
lines.en: I fell from the stone and struck my shell
Water touched me and my strength went
The blast threw me into the fire
An arrow is in my leg

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进壳缝，像针
lines.en: That force came through a seam like a needle

lines.zh: 这一片烧得什么都没有
lines.en: This stretch is burnt to nothing

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我半边身子僵了
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me and half of me stiffened
There is no ash to hide in here
